annotations.title: Find an ImgVX AI image tool

description: Finds the free ImgVX AI browser tool for an image task the user describes, such as removing a background, upscaling, erasing an object, enhancing or colorizing a photo, compressing to a file size, resizing, cropping or converting HEIC, PNG, JPG, WebP or PDF. Returns matching tools with what each does and a link to open it; every tool is free with no sign-up. This tool does not edit images itself: the user opens the link and edits the image in their own browser.

language.description: Optional: the user's language, for a link to the page in that language where one exists.

task.description: What the user wants to do to their image, in a few words (e.g. "remove background", "make photo 4x bigger", "compress to 100 KB").

name: find_image_tool
title: Find an ImgVX AI image tool
